title: 외국법자문사법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Eligibility Criteria for the Ministry of Justice's Foreign Legal Advisor Disciplinary Committee) In accordance with Article 40(2) of the Act, the Minister of Justice appoints or designates individuals who meet the following criteria as members and reserve members of the Ministry of Justice's Foreign Legal Advisor Disciplinary Committee (hereinafter referred to as "the Disciplinary Committee"):

1. Members and reserve members as specified in Article 40(2)(2) of the Act: Prosecutors with more than 10 years of experience in the positions specified in Article 42(1) of the "Act on the Organization of Courts."
2. Members and reserve members as specified in Article 40(2)(3) of the Act: Foreign legal advisors or foreign lawyers who have obtained a foreign lawyer license and completed all necessary procedures in their home country, and have more than 10 years of experience in performing legal work related to foreign law.
3. Members and reserve members as specified in Article 40(2)(5) of the Act: Any of the following individuals:
    a. Individuals with extensive legal knowledge and experience, such as professors or lecturers at law schools or graduate schools, with more than 5 years of experience.
    b. Individuals with a stable occupation.

Individuals with over 10 years of experience in social activities, or individuals recommended by a non-profit private organization as defined in Article 2 of the "Non-profit Private Organization Support Act".
